name: work-loop-shipped-sha-after-branch-delete
title: Work-loop ledger gaps: lastShippedSha after branch delete, and no skip from selected
description: sd-work-backlog tells the controller to record branch, head, and the final shipped feature SHA after housekeeping returns, but housekeeping has already deleted the merged feature branch by then. Three validations in sd-ai-command-pack-work-loop.py reject every ordering of that call, and each rejection drives contextHealth to red on an iteration that actually merged cleanly. Observed on run 17ab8b28, iteration 2, PR #153. Second gap in the same run: LEGAL_TRANSITIONS gives 'selected' no route to 'inventory' or 'complete', so the skill's documented 'skip current' control has no sanctioned implementation when a PRD read after selection disqualifies the task.
